title: 17 July 1961: Live: Litherland Town Hall, Liverpool
content:
This was The Beatles’ 10th show at Litherland Town Hall, where they had given a triumphant homecoming performance on 27 December 1960, following their first trip to Hamburg.

The Beatles played at the venue on 20 separate occasions between December 1960 and 9 November 1961.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024
